# Jan Vestergaard

Jan Vestergaard is a practising specialist physician in psychiatry ("praktiserende speciallæge i psykiatri") based in Region Hovedstaden, Denmark [^src1][^src2]. He is listed as a member of the steering group ("styregruppen") for the Danish ADHD-databasen, the national health-quality database that monitors the diagnosis and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 years of age.

He appears in the steering-group membership lists published in two consecutive annual reports of the ADHD database: the 2023 report [^src1] and the 2024 report [^src2]. In the later document his professional affiliation is given in fuller form, identifying him not only by his regional workplace but also as a member of the "Forening af praktiserende speciallæger" (the Association of Practising Specialist Physicians) [^src2]. Both mentions place him professionally in Region Hovedstaden, one of Denmark's five administrative health regions [^src2].

Jan Vestergaard's role fits into the broader structure of the ADHD database's steering group, which draws together senior physicians, specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists and relative/patient representatives from across Denmark to oversee quality monitoring of ADHD assessment and treatment. The database itself tracks statistics on children and young people assessed or treated for ADHD, including data such as educational outcomes, showing markedly lower rates of passing the final primary-school exam (folkeskolens afgangsprøve) before age 17 among children with ADHD compared with the background population.

No further biographical detail, claims, or timeline events are available for Jan Vestergaard beyond his listed steering-group membership and regional affiliation.
